baseline.input_source: Original committed Git blobs read using git cat-file --batch; not the regenerated working-tree assets.

method.purpose: Join mechanically decidable specification/model flags to the separate personal visual-screening ledger.
method.not_signoff: No visual or physical sign-off implied. no_rule_match means only that these specific predicates did not match.
method.classification_note: defect and metadata_inconsistency record contradictions; mechanism_review_flag, diversity_review_flag and appearance_review_flag require interpretation; appearance_limitation and motion_limitation record restricted fidelity.
method.counting: Each issue/subissue reports distinct affected_ids. Counts overlap. Global statistics do not assign per-door flags.
method.sources: Per-finding source functions and reasoning are in audit_document. Baseline hashes are included for each door.
method.validation: Every original Git blob parsed; manifest/spec hash assertions and 16 key predicate count assertions passed.

render_ledger_validation.scope: Verified every exported baseline model hash equals the model hash in the original per-door inspection render record.

global_statistics.scope: Descriptive whole-dataset statistics, not individual door defects.
